title: Register and Controller
expectedPositive: Click or keyboard-activate the rating button twice, then submit; the handler must receive rating 3 rather than 1. Verify the title is also registered.
expectedNegative: The custom control never receives the form-owned value or onChange handler.
securityBoundary: A rating picker still needs a semantic accessible name and keyboard focus; wrapping an inaccessible custom control in Controller does not make it accessible.
